overall: The AG found the Boxborough Finance Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by responding 21 days late, past the 14-business-day deadline, to an earlier complaint, and ordered future compliance.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Finance Committee failed to timely respond to an earlier Open Meeting Law complaint filed in October 2022.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee failed to respond to an Open Meeting Law complaint within 14 business days, we find that it violated the Open Meeting Law.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
